title: Test Automation Engineer
description:
Job Details Location: Jaipur Job Type: Full Time Qualifications: Any Graduations (BCA, MCA, Btech) Experience Required: 3-7 years Job Summary The Test Automation Engineer is responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining scalable automated testing solutions across CIMET's CAAS platform. The role will drive quality engineering practices through robust end-to-end automation, regression testing, CI/CD integration, and risk-based testing approaches. Working closely with Product, Engineering, and QA teams, the Test Automation Engineer will ensure reliable, high-quality software delivery across Energy, Telco, Credit Cards, PHI, and future product verticals. Key Accountabilities Test Automation Development Design, develop, and maintain end-to-end automated test suites using Playwright and TypeScript. Build and maintain reusable Page Object Models (POM) and shared testing utilities. Integrate automated testing into CI/CD pipelines to support continuous quality assurance. Contribute to scalable automation frameworks that support multiple product verticals. Support cross-browser and cross-device testing capabilities. Test Strategy Coverage Collaborate with Product and Engineering teams to understand business requirements and define test coverage. Develop test scenarios covering happy paths, edge cases, negative testing, regression, and sanity suites. Identify automation gaps and prioritize coverage based on business risk and release impact. Maintain quality coverage across multiple consumer product journeys. Quality Assurance Defect Management Execute and monitor automated regression and sanity suites. Investigate, document, and report defects with clear reproduction steps and severity assessments. Diagnose flaky tests and resolve root causes proactively. Produce test evidence and quality metrics to support release decisions and defect tracking. Manual Exploratory Testing Conduct structured exploratory testing to identify defects outside automated coverage. Execute manual test cases for high-risk scenarios and UAT activities. Apply risk-based testing methodologies to optimize testing effort and release confidence. Continuously assess product quality and user experience across critical customer journeys. Collaboration Documentation Work within Agile/Scrum teams alongside Product Managers, Developers, and QA professionals. Maintain test documentation, coverage matrices, and test repositories in Jira and Confluence. Contribute to QA standards, best practices, and knowledge-sharing initiatives. Participate in sprint ceremonies, defect triage sessions, and continuous improvement activities. Your Skills and Experience 5+ years of experience in test automation using Playwright, Cypress, or similar automation frameworks. Strong hands-on experience with TypeScript or JavaScript for developing and maintaining automated test suites. Proven experience building scalable automation frameworks using Page Object Model (POM) and reusable test components. Strong proficiency in Playwright (TypeScript) for end-to-end and cross-browser automation testing. Experience integrating automated testing into CI/CD pipelines and continuous delivery processes. Experience with API testing and implementing API validations within automated test suites. Sound understanding of STLC, SDLC, Agile/Scrum methodologies, and quality engineering best practices. Hands-on experience in manual, exploratory, regression, sanity, and risk-based testing approaches. Strong debugging, troubleshooting, root-cause analysis, and defect management capabilities. Experience creating and maintaining test cases from user stories, acceptance criteria, and product requirements. Proficiency with Jira, Confluence, Git/GitHub, Allure Reporting, and modern QA tooling. Experience using AI-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot, Cursor AI, or Claude Code to improve productivity and test automation outcomes. Familiarity with BrowserStack, accessibility testing (WCAG), visual regression testing, and performance testing tools such as k6 or JMeter. ISTQB certification or equivalent QA qualification will be highly regarded. Strong communication, stakeholder management, collaboration, and prioritisation skills with the ability to thrive in a fast-paced, high-growth environment. Demonstrated ownership mindset, attention to detail, and commitment to delivering high-quality software solutions. Challenges of the Position Rapid Growth - CIMET will grow massively over the next 2 years, and we need to build and onboard a team of high-performing people to enable the planned growth to reach fruition. Systems - CIMET is in the growth phase of the expansion, where systems, processes and policies are being developed and implemented. This means there will be constant changes occurring and you will need to be agile in your approach to changing business priorities.

title: Software Development Engineer

You will work closely with cross-functional teams to deliverhigh-quality software products that meet the needs of our clients andcontribute to the success of our organization.
